about: How well-known quests start, from UESP, to test the planner's start data (WO-121). startsWith lists every way UESP describes; the planner's giver must be one of them and its first step must match firstObjective. Vanilla and DLC as UESP writes them; where LoreRim changes a quest (a level gate, a mod's own start), the planner's checked data wins and the row's loreRim note says so. Checked by Bob from UESP's pages, 20 Oct 2026.
